name: threadlines-rooms-launch-video
description: Remotion edits for the Threadlines launch videos (landscape, portrait, square): Rooms (0.5.0), agents starting threads (0.6.0) and Fleet (0.8.0).

scripts.render: npm run render:landscape && npm run render:portrait && npm run render:square && npm run render:posters
scripts.render:x: ffmpeg -v error -y -ss 1.8 -i out/rooms-promo-square.mp4 -vf tpad=start_duration=0.8:start_mode=clone -an -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart out/rooms-promo-x.mp4
scripts.render:site: remotion render RoomsSiteClip out/rooms-site.mp4 --crf 23 && remotion still RoomsSitePoster out/rooms-site-poster.png && remotion render RoomsSiteClipTall out/rooms-site-tall.mp4 --crf 23 && remotion still RoomsSitePosterTall out/rooms-site-tall-poster.png
scripts.render:posters: remotion still RoomsPosterLandscape out/rooms-promo-landscape-poster.png && remotion still RoomsPosterPortrait out/rooms-promo-portrait-poster.png && remotion still RoomsPosterSquare out/rooms-promo-square-poster.png
scripts.render:threads: npm run render:threads:landscape && npm run render:threads:portrait && npm run render:threads:square && npm run render:threads:posters
scripts.render:threads:x: ffmpeg -v error -y -ss 1.8 -i out/threads-promo-square.mp4 -vf tpad=start_duration=0.8:start_mode=clone -an -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart out/threads-promo-x.mp4
scripts.render:threads:site: remotion render ThreadsSiteClip out/threads-site.mp4 --crf 23 && remotion still ThreadsSitePoster out/threads-site-poster.png && remotion render ThreadsSiteClipTall out/threads-site-tall.mp4 --crf 23 && remotion still ThreadsSitePosterTall out/threads-site-tall-poster.png
scripts.render:threads:posters: remotion still ThreadsPosterLandscape out/threads-promo-landscape-poster.png && remotion still ThreadsPosterPortrait out/threads-promo-portrait-poster.png && remotion still ThreadsPosterSquare out/threads-promo-square-poster.png
scripts.render:fleet: npm run render:fleet:landscape && npm run render:fleet:portrait && npm run render:fleet:square && npm run render:fleet:posters
scripts.render:fleet:x: ffmpeg -v error -y -ss 1.8 -i out/fleet-promo-square.mp4 -vf tpad=start_duration=0.8:start_mode=clone -an -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart out/fleet-promo-x.mp4
scripts.render:fleet:site: remotion render FleetSiteClip out/fleet-site.mp4 --crf 23 && remotion still FleetSitePoster out/fleet-site-poster.png && remotion render FleetSiteClipTall out/fleet-site-tall.mp4 --crf 23 && remotion still FleetSitePosterTall out/fleet-site-tall-poster.png
